# BrandOps

## Description

BrandOps is a review-first content workspace for solo operators, trainers, coaches, consultants, SaaS founders, and personal brands. It turns one research topic into a LinkedIn carousel and a cited newsletter, with a human approval gate before anything publishes.

## Key pages

- [BrandOps](https://www.brandops.site/): Review-first personal brand content automation for LinkedIn carousels, newsletters, and AI-assisted research.
- [LinkedIn Carousel Generator](https://www.brandops.site/linkedin-carousel-generator): Generate cited, review-ready LinkedIn carousels from one research topic.
- [AI Newsletter Generator](https://www.brandops.site/ai-newsletter-generator): Generate cited newsletters from current research with review-gated sending.
- [LinkedIn Automation Tool](https://www.brandops.site/linkedin-automation-tool): AI content workspace for founders and trainers.
- [LinkedIn Automation Tool for Coaches](https://www.brandops.site/linkedin-automation-tool-for-coaches): AI content workflow built for coaches.
- [LinkedIn Automation Tool for Consultants](https://www.brandops.site/linkedin-automation-tool-for-consultants): AI content workflow built for consultants.
- [LinkedIn Automation Tool for SaaS Founders](https://www.brandops.site/linkedin-automation-tool-for-saas-founders): AI content workflow built for SaaS founders.
- [Pricing](https://www.brandops.site/pricing): Free Solo plan and Operator plan details.
- [Book a Demo](https://www.brandops.site/demo): 30-minute BrandOps walkthrough.
